briefing: Market is neutral today (NASDAQ +0.4%, S&P 500 +0.2%) with no broad risk-on signal, so we're not forcing multiple buys just to deploy the $689 in cash. NVDA stood out with all five technical signals confirming institutional-grade momentum, so we're adding one high-conviction position and holding the rest of cash and all 7 existing positions steady.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Signal confluence means waiting for several independent technical indicators — like a bullish MACD crossover, healthy RSI, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — to all line up before making a high-conviction trade. A single signal can be noise, but when multiple signals agree, it's more likely real institutional buying is happening.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 訊號共振是指等待多個獨立的技術指標——例如MACD黃金交叉、合理的RSI水平、股價高於平均線，以及成交量放大——同時出現，才進行高信心的交易。單一訊號可能只是雜訊，但當多項訊號同時確認時，更有可能代表真實的機構資金流入。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly higher today with the NASDAQ up 0.4% and the S&P 500 up 0.2%, a quiet, low-volatility session without a clear macro catalyst. Semiconductor and AI-adjacent names like NVDA and SIMO showed standout relative strength with bullish MACD crossovers and volume surges, suggesting sector-specific buying rather than a market-wide move. Overall breadth was mixed, consistent with a neutral, wait-and-see tone among investors.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢溫和向上，納指升0.4%，標普500指數升0.2%，屬於波動較低、缺乏明顯宏觀催化劑的一個交易日。半導體及AI相關股份如NVDA及SIMO表現相對強勢，出現MACD黃金交叉及成交量放大的訊號，反映資金更多集中於個別板塊而非全面性升市。整體市場廣度參差，投資者情緒偏向中性觀望。

trades.reasoning: Full multi-signal confirmation (RSI 68.6 in bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover with rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) makes this the strongest candidate on the board.
